# Arfaa Law Group

> > Arfaa Law Group is a Baltimore-based law firm specializing in medical malpractice and birth injury litigation in Maryland.

The firm focuses on representing clients in complex medical malpractice cases, birth injuries, and related personal injury matters. Led by experienced attorneys Julia R. Arfaa and Matthew B. Thompson, the firm offers free consultations and operates on a no-fee guarantee basis for clients.
